reason: This looks high-risk and central: it couples a `client-go` dependency update with `read ts` verification changes across `planner`, `executor`, `sessionctx`, `sessiontxn/staleread`, and `store/copr` (`batch_coprocessor`, `batch_request_sender`, `mpp`). That combination can affect snapshot/stale-read semantics, request timestamp correctness, and distributed read consistency across normal cop, batch cop, and MPP paths. Changes in `planbuilder.go`, `set.go`, and session context interfaces also raise the chance of user-visible SQL/session behavior shifts rather than a narrow local fix.
